svg.aria-label: An agent asked to clean up test orders deletes far too much. Nothing is deleted: it is a proposal. The approver sees its size first, then why it has come to a person, then the rows. She rejects it and says why. The agent reads the reason. The agent proposes the twelve rows that were meant. Approving asks once more. The approval is for these rows and no others. The second key is turned. Only now can the change be written. The agent applies it: twelve rows, exactly the ones approved, exactly once. And an applied change can be taken back: every row as it was before.

g.text: An agent asked to clean up test orders deletes far too much. Nothing is deleted: it is a proposal.
The approver sees its size first, then why it has come to a person, then the rows.
She rejects it and says why. The agent reads the reason.
The agent proposes the twelve rows that were meant.
Approving asks once more. The approval is for these rows and no others.
The second key is turned. Only now can the change be written.
The agent applies it: twelve rows, exactly the ones approved, exactly once.
And an applied change can be taken back: every row as it was before.
